online.REQUEST_TO_BUY: Online request to buy (becomes a quote)

products.title: Products
products.searchLabel: Search products by name or SKU
products.emptyBody: Try another search or status, or add a product.
products.denied: You do not have access to products

product.notFound: There is no product at this address
product.error: This product could not be loaded
product.denied: You do not have access to this product
product.policyFixed: How stock is kept cannot change once the product has stock history.
product.editHint: Only what you change is sent. If someone else saved first, you will be asked to reload.
product.onlineHint: Live animals are offered online as a request to buy, which becomes a quote.
product.archiveHint: An archived product stays in history and on every document that used it. It can no longer be sold or bought.
product.archiveBody: It stays in history. Say why, for the audit log.

create.title: New product
create.hint: Choose how stock is kept with care: it cannot change once the product has stock history.
create.referenceMissing: There are no categories or units to choose from
create.referenceError: Categories, units or species could not be loaded
create.referenceDenied: You cannot see the categories, units or species a product needs
create.tooMany: There are more categories, units or species than this form can offer
create.tooManyBody: Tell support: this form reads at most five pages of each list.
create.policyHint: Individual animals for goats, sheep and pigs; weighed lots for meat; counted units for eggs and produce.
create.baseUomHint: The unit stock is counted or weighed in.
create.packHint: For packs sold by weight, for example 15.000.
create.skuGiven: Given by the server when the product is saved. It is never typed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.newBody: The product line and ledger group cannot change after the category is created.
categories.editBody: The code, product line and ledger group are fixed.
categories.archiveBody: It stays in history. Say why, for the audit log.
categories.emptyBody: Add a category before adding products.
categories.denied: You do not have access to categories
categories.taxError: Tax categories could not be loaded, so none can be chosen.

units.title: Units
units.intro: The units stock is counted, weighed and sold in. Units are set up by the system and cannot be changed here.
units.emptyBody: The system has no units of measure yet.
units.denied: You do not have access to units

species.title: Species, grades and bands
species.intro: Grades and weight bands per species are what price bands and quotes are set against.
species.emptyBody: Species are added before animals can be registered.
species.denied: You do not have access to species

speciesDetail.notFound: There is no species at this address
speciesDetail.error: This species could not be loaded
speciesDetail.denied: You do not have access to this species

grades.title: Grades
grades.dialogBody: A grade describes an animal's quality, for example well finished or lean.
grades.archiveBody: Prices already set against it keep it. Say why, for the audit log.
grades.emptyBody: Add a grade to price by quality.
grades.denied: You do not have access to grades

bands.title: Weight bands
bands.rule: A band runs from its lower weight, included, up to its upper weight, not included.
bands.archiveBody: Prices already set against it keep it. Say why, for the audit log.
bands.notArchived: The weight band was not archived
bands.empty: No weight bands for this species
bands.emptyBody: Add bands to price animals by size.
bands.error: Weight bands could not be loaded
bands.denied: You do not have access to weight bands
bands.kgFormat: Enter kilograms with three places, for example 18.000.
bands.notSaved: The weight band was not saved

priceLists.title: Price lists
priceLists.intro: A sale is priced from the customer's own list, then their tier, then the channel, then the base list.
priceLists.emptyBody: A base price list is needed before anything can be priced.
priceLists.error: Price lists could not be loaded
priceLists.denied: You do not have access to price lists

priceList.notFound: There is no price list at this address
priceList.error: This price list could not be loaded
priceList.denied: You do not have access to this price list
priceList.hasDraft: This price list already has a draft.
priceList.newVersionCopies: The draft starts as a copy of version {{number}}, so you change only what moves.
priceList.newVersionEmpty: There is no version in force, so the draft starts empty.
priceList.validFromHint: From the start of that day, Accra time. Nothing changes until another person approves it.

version.title: {{name}}, version {{number}}
version.notFound: There is no price list version at this address
version.error: This price list version could not be loaded
version.denied: You do not have access to this price list
version.awaiting: Sent for approval. Nothing has changed yet: the prices below take effect only when another person approves.
version.entriesError: The lines could not be loaded
version.tooMany: This price list has more lines than the preview can compare
version.tooManyBody: No partial preview is shown, because a missing line would look like a dropped price. Tell support: the preview reads at most five pages of 100 lines.

preview.title: Preview before it takes effect
preview.against: Each line beside the same line in version {{number}}, which is in force now.
preview.noActive: No version is in force, so every line is new.
preview.table: Preview of the draft against the prices in force

entry.editBody: Amounts in cedis. The server checks the floor, list and ceiling against each other.
entry.quoteOnlyHint: The line cannot be sold at a list price; it becomes a quote.
entry.saved: Prices of {{name}} saved in the draft
entry.removeBody: From the draft's start the line will no longer be priced by this list.
entry.addTitle: Add a price to the draft
entry.addBody: A crate and a single egg are two prices of their own. Amounts in cedis; the server checks the floor, list and ceiling against each other.
entry.added: A price for {{name}} added to the draft
entry.unitHint: The unit the customer buys: a crate or a single egg.
entry.minQtyHint: Leave empty for any quantity. A bulk buyer's break, for example from 10, counted in {{unit}}.

submit.title: Submit this draft for approval?
submit.body: Another person with approval rights must approve it. Until then nothing changes.
submit.pending: Sent for approval. Nothing has changed yet: the prices take effect only when another person approves.
submit.activated: The draft was approved and will take effect from its start.

buyer.title: Give these prices to a buyer
buyer.intro: A buyer on this list is priced from it first: its crate price, its single egg price and its quantity breaks. A buyer has one list at a time.
buyer.untilHint: Optional. After it, the buyer goes back to their tier's prices.
buyer.untilWrong: The last day must be after the first.
buyer.replaces: I understand this replaces any list the buyer has from that day
buyer.replacesRequired: Tick this to give the buyer these prices.
buyer.notSaved: The buyer was not given these prices
buyer.denied: You cannot give buyers a price list
buyer.openEnded: Until another list is given to them.

newBuyerList.open: New price list for a buyer
newBuyerList.title: New price list for a buyer
newBuyerList.intro: For a hotel, a chop bar or a reseller buying in bulk. Its prices go in a draft, which another person approves; then give it to the buyer.
newBuyerList.name: Name
newBuyerList.codeHint: Capital letters, digits and hyphens, for example CUST-ASANTEWAA.
newBuyerList.codeWrong: Use 2 to 40 capital letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
newBuyerList.taxInclusiveHint: Ticked, the buyer pays the price shown; not ticked, levies are added on top.
newBuyerList.notSaved: The price list was not created
